claim: Pipeline parallel is the preferred starting point on this hardware because it communicates stage boundaries instead of frequent full-tensor collectives.
stance_target: The repo's claim that PP is the viable multi-GPU topology on a no-NVLink PCIe fabric
scope_conditions: CMP 170HX cluster with no NVLink, PCIe links that may negotiate conservatively under virtualization
quoted_support: Pipeline parallel | Preferred starting point | Communicates stage boundaries instead of frequent full-tensor collectives

claim: Tensor parallel should be used only after measurement, because all-reduce traffic can erase compute gains on slow PCIe.
stance_target: The repo's stronger claim that TP is ruled out by the fabric - the community doc treats it as unmeasured rather than impossible
quoted_support: Tensor parallel | Use only after measurement | All-reduce traffic can erase compute gains on slow PCIe

claim: Expert parallel is workload-dependent rather than ruled out: routing traffic and runtime support must be measured.
stance_target: The repo's claim that expert parallelism is ruled out by the fabric
quoted_support: Expert parallel | Workload-dependent | Routing traffic and runtime support must be measured

claim: Data parallel is good for independent jobs and throughput, but each replica needs its own weights or a suitable sharding design.
stance_target: The repo's claim that DDP is the viable topology, while flagging the memory cost of replication
quoted_support: Data parallel | Good for independent jobs/throughput | Each replica needs its own weights or a suitable sharding design

claim: There is no NVLink in the tested configuration and PCIe links may negotiate conservatively under virtualization, which changes which parallelism strategy wins.
stance_target: The repo's no-NVLink claim, and its pre-flight warning that negotiated link state can silently invalidate results
quoted_support: There is no NVLink in the tested configuration. PCIe links may also negotiate conservatively under virtualization. This changes which parallelism strategy wins.

claim: A three-card DeepSeek-V4-Flash result validates pipeline parallelism as a practical path, but does not prove PP is optimal for every model.
stance_target: The repo's PP precedent, with an explicit scope limit
quoted_support: The three-card DeepSeek-V4-Flash result validates pipeline parallelism as a practical path. It does not prove pipeline parallel is optimal for every model.
